# Everything about legacy weapons

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_12_nukaknights-post-legacy-weapons.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update January 24th, 2023]** In Patch 41, almost all legendary legacy effects have now been deactivated. Explo energy weapons no longer have an Explo effect, Fatman has no FFR, etc. The only known Legacy weapon that is not affected is the Legacy Dragon. If you know of other untouched legacy weapons, please write in the comments. (See: Fallout 76 - Patch Notes – January 24th, 2023 (Patch 41), Upcoming Changes in Patch 41 on January 24th, 2023 (Illegal Weapons & Mod Removal))

**Original post:**

You all probably come across this term several times a day here in the Nuka Knights group and on Facebook. Some confuse **legendary** weapons with **legacy** and some think there's nothing else in Fallout 76 worth playing. The latter is of course not the case, but that is not the point here.

## WHAT DOES “LEGACY” EVEN MEAN?

"Legacy" means that it is a weapon that no longer drops in the game. Not through enemies, not through the legendary trader, not through events, nor through dailies or operations.

Such items can only get into your inventory through trading with other players.

## WHICH WEAPONS ARE “LEGACY”?

Basically, all energy weapons/flamethrowers/cryolators that have “bullets explode and cause area damage” as their second legendary perk. Because Bethesda decided in **Patch 5 on January 29th, 2019** that **Energy weapons can no longer drop with the Explo** perk.

There are also a few cases of weapons being removed from the loot pool.

## LIST OF ALL LEGACY WEAPONS

- 
Laser Rifles with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / January 29, 2019)
- 
Gatling Laser with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / January 29, 2019)
- 
Gatling Plasma with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / January 29, 2019)
- 
Flamethrower with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / January 29, 2019)
- 
Cryolator with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / January 29, 2019)
- 
~~Radium with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / 01/29/2019) (The RAD damage classifies it as an energy weapon)~~
Radium with Explo Perk can drop again in the game from Patch 40 / December 6th, 2022. (No longer classified as an energy weapon)
- 
Aggressotron head with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / January 29, 2019)
- 
Tesla Rifle with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / January 29, 2019)
- 
Ultrazit Laser with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / 01/29/2019)
- 
Gauss Rifle with Explo Perk (Patch 5 / January 29, 2019)
- 
Harpoons with Explo Perk (Patch 18 / April 14, 2020)
- 
All weapons with the legendary 1st perk: Double
- 
Golden minigun
- 
Quadruple crossbow
- 
Crossbow 250 damage resistance versions with medic or 25% higher rate of fire
- 
Dragon with bayonet
- 
Tesla Rifle with Lobber Mod
- 
2+ stars Chain Blade (1* can drop from the machine during Monster Mania)
- 
Gauss Shotgun with Explo Perk (Patch 24 / November 24th, 2020) <-Dropping again (as of December 16th, 2021)
- 
Red fireworks mine
- 
The Eviscerator (without the Settlers livery)
- 
All weapons that could be earned in survival mode e.g. The Action Hero, The Unstoppable Monster, etc.
- 
Single-shot weapons can no longer drop with a higher rate of fire: Fatman, Black Powder Rifle, M79 Grenade Launcher (Patch 28 / July 7th, 2021)
- 
Stalker melee weapons (Patch 28 / July 7th, 2021)
- 
Single-shot ranged weapons can no longer spawn with the Last Shot legendary attribute. (Patch 29 / August 3, 2021)
- 
Pepper Shakers with Explo (In Patch 28, a possibility came into play to get pepper shakers with Explo as a reward from allies in CAMP. This Explo Drop has now been removed in Patch 30 on September 8th, 2021.)
- 
Quadruple Gatling Laser / Gatling Plasma (03/01/2022)

## WHY ARE SOME “LEGACIES” SO STRONG AND IN SEARCH?

Explosive energy weapons in particular are still in high demand and often multiply in mysterious ways.
